walkthroughs.description: Why Foundry Copilot disables GitHub Copilot extensions on activation, and how to configure the policy.

steps.title: Why a BAA matters
steps.description: GitHub Copilot ships without a Business Associate Agreement. Foundry runs in your Azure tenant under the standard Microsoft EA BAA. Foundry Copilot enforces this boundary at activation.

foundryCopilot.endpoint.markdownDescription: Your Microsoft Foundry endpoint URL. Must end in one of: `.services.ai.azure.com`, `.cognitiveservices.azure.com`, `.openai.azure.com`, or `.inference.ml.azure.com`. The sidecar **rejects everything else** (hard lock).
foundryCopilot.endpoint.patternErrorMessage: Endpoint must be HTTPS and end in a Microsoft Foundry domain (.services.ai.azure.com, .cognitiveservices.azure.com, .openai.azure.com, or .inference.ml.azure.com).

foundryCopilot.embeddingDeployment.description: Deployment name for embeddings (used by RAG).

foundryCopilot.agent.allowWrite.markdownDescription: Permit the `fs_write` tool. **Disabled by default** for safety; turn on to let the agent create/overwrite files in the workspace.

foundryCopilot.agent.allowShell.markdownDescription: Permit the `shell` tool. **Disabled by default** for safety; turn on to let the agent run shell commands in the workspace.

foundryCopilot.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to launch on activation. Each entry is `{ id, command, args?, env? }`. Tools exposed by these servers become available to the agent loop as `mcp__{id}__{tool}`.

id.description: Stable id used in tool names.

foundryCopilot.baa.enforcement.markdownDescription: How to handle conflicting GitHub Copilot extensions. **`auto`**: silently disable on activation. **`prompt`**: ask once with a modal. **`off`**: do nothing (UNPROTECTED — status bar turns red).

foundryCopilot.baa.conflictingExtensions.markdownDescription: Additional extension IDs to treat as conflicts on top of the built-in list (`GitHub.copilot`, `GitHub.copilot-chat`, `GitHub.copilot-workspace`, `GitHub.copilot-labs`).

foundryCopilot.baa.target.description: Scope at which to disable conflicting extensions.

foundryCopilot.lmProvider.enabled.markdownDescription: Register a `vscode.lm.registerChatModelProvider` so Foundry deployments appear in the standard Select Model picker (requires VS Code build with the proposed API).

foundryCopilot.nes.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Next Edit Suggestions (inline completions powered by the NES predictor). Adds latency; opt-in.

foundryCopilot.telemetry.localStore.description: Append every Foundry call to a local JSONL telemetry store under your config dir. Local-only; never sent off-machine unless you also configure the OTLP exporter.

foundryCopilot.telemetry.otlpEndpoint.markdownDescription: OTLP HTTP endpoint for outbound telemetry export. **Required AND** `foundryCopilot.telemetry.otlpAllowedHosts` must list the endpoint host or the export is refused.

foundryCopilot.telemetry.otlpAllowedHost.markdownDescription: Allow-list of OTLP destination hosts. The endpoint host must match (dot-anchored) one of these or the exporter refuses to send.

foundryCopilot.billing.dailyBudgetUsd.description: Daily budget in USD. When tracked Foundry spend crosses this, a one-time alert fires (at most once per UTC day). 0 disables alerting.
